source.title: Beast Collector's Cudgel, 12.1.7 PTR item-side Looter disenchanting
source.author: Wowhead Looter contributors (unknown)

notes: Row 1/2 of one indexed PTR cumulative item-side Looter snapshot: 182 source-reported historical disenchants; this material row appeared 94 times (shown rounded 52%). Same-name Dawn Crystal rows are distinct but linked output item IDs and quality ranks are not visible. Output total units, actual per-cast original event data, skill/spec/build, at-cast bonus/ilvl, zero-inclusive histograms and confirmed live eligibility unknown. Base tooltip ilvl197 and selected Mythic 6/6 ilvl289 are NOT at-cast levels. PTR-2 12.1.5 snapshot 171 and 90/77 is a different cumulative view, not new independent casts. Never treat residual 182-94-83 as known zero-yield events; reference only, not Retail live baseline.
